Uwasa no Midori-kun!! Summary
The Rumoured Midori-kun!!, Shounen x Cinderella II is a romantic comedy manga that follows Yamate Midori, a spirited 15-year-old tomboy. Her life takes a dramatic turn when she meets Hino Tsukasa, a visiting boy who introduces her to the exhilarating world of soccer.
Smitten with both the sport and Tsukasa, Midori dedicates herself to soccer, hoping for a reunion. However, when they meet again, Tsukasa commits an unforgivable act, fueling Midori's resolve to challenge him on the soccer field. This ambition leads her to enroll in an all-boys high school.
The series features a bright and expressive art style with large, sparkling eyes and dynamic character designs, characteristic of shoujo manga, that effectively conveys the emotional highs and lows of Midori's journey. The narrative blends humor, budding romance, and the intense drama of competitive sports.

Uwasa no Midori-kun!! ( うわさの翠くん!! ; lit. ' The Rumored Midori-kun!!
' ) is a Japanese manga series written and illustrated by Gō Ikeyamada . It premiered in Shōjo Comic from December 2006 to October 2008. The individual chapters were collected and published in 10 tankōbon volumes by Shogakukan . Two of its chapters are used in Gō Ikeyamada's Shōnen x Cinderella .
[ edit ]
The manga was adapted into a Nintendo DS game called Uwasa no Midori-kun!! Natsu Iro Striker ( うわさの翠くん!! 夏色ストライカー ) , which was released by Idea Factory on September 20, 2007. Drama CD

Based on the manga, a Drama CD , called Uwasa no Midori-kun!! Futari no Oji to Hadaka Hime no Fukushu , was released on March 5, 2008, by Sony Music Entertainment . The songs are sung by Hikaru Midorikawa , Akira Ishida , Romi Park and Kazuya Nakai . [ 6 ]

HEROINE: Yamate Midori — 15-year-old tomboy from an island who, after a betrayal, disguises herself as a boy to enroll at Aoba 3rd High School (all-boys high) and play soccer; a dormmate discovers her gender almost immediately [1].

THE "CHILDCHILDHOOD FRIEND" — NAME & WHAT HE DID: He is Hino Tsukasa (17, 2nd year at Jōsei High; the manga calls him her first love, not a lifelong childhood friend — minor discrepancy with the user's framing: he's the boy who vacationed on her island and taught her soccer, not a raised-alongside friend [1][2]). After they reunite, Tsukasa bets with his teammates that he can seduce her; on their first date he convinces her to give up her virginity (which she'd been saving for her future husband) with the promise they will marry; the next day she learns it was a bet, and he mocks her as an easy "country girl" and tells her she should be proud to have been intimate with a future soccer star [1]. FINAL PAIRING — DISCREPANCY FLAGGED: The user's memory that the bad childhood friend ends up with her is WRONG. Tsukasa does fall in love with her and the two date for a while after reconciling, but "it doesn't work out" [1]. The actual final pairing is Kazuma Shinbashi (15, Aoba 3rd 1st-year, her dormmate who knows she's a girl, loves her, and acts as her protector). Midori develops feelings for Kazuma, lets go of Tsukasa, confesses, they begin dating; he proposes after graduation, they marry and have a daughter (Akane) on Midori's island; in the epilogue Tsukasa appears married to another woman with a son, Kakeru [1].

MATURE/SEXUAL CONTENT — CATALOGED: Yes, the manga portrays sexual content: the bet-driven virginity/seduction scene, and Tsukasa "constantly harasses her sexually when they are alone" [1]. However it is not cataloged as an explicit/adult work: it ran in mainstream shōjo magazine Shōjo Comic and is classified romantic comedy/sports [1][3].
